description: Curated plugin references for the thin Craft kernel. Craft itself does not implement these; it lists external plugins for users to install. Host resolution follows catalog/host-priority.json.

bundled.name: craft-context
bundled.description: Default Craft context entry: Knowledge, Memory, Experience, Codebase with bounded receipts.

bundled.name: craft-datasec
bundled.description: Default local text redaction hook; no Context or MCP dependency.

craft_optional_source_plugins.name: craft-file-dir-desc
craft_optional_source_plugins.description: Directory semantic descriptions from craft-capability source; source-built plugin, not published in this marketplace package yet.

recommended.name: github
recommended.description: Repositories, issues and pull requests; read-first

recommended.name: agent-browser
recommended.description: Headless browser navigation for local verification

recommended.name: serena
recommended.description: Semantic code retrieval and symbol editing (workspace-scoped)

recommended.name: hookify
recommended.description: Declarative Host hooks without shell execution

recommended.name: sentry
recommended.description: Read-only error monitoring and issue triage

high_risk_not_default.name: computer-use
high_risk_not_default.description: Desktop/GUI control; screen, keyboard and local app access

high_risk_not_default.name: agent-desktop
high_risk_not_default.description: Desktop automation agent; can act outside the workspace

high_risk_not_default.name: browser-use
high_risk_not_default.description: Autonomous browser actions including form submission

remote_message.description: Remote message control is a local, pull-only capability: Craft reads a GitHub repo or mounted drop directory on an interval, redacts summaries and stores inbox items. It never sends messages or stores credentials in settings.json. Outbound messaging requires an explicitly authorized plugin.

industry_note: Recommendations are catalog entries, not bundled payloads. Craft lists them for user installation; host resolution follows catalog/host-priority.json.

custom_import.description: Users may import any external plugin manifest. Resolution order is fixed by host-priority.json; an imported plugin that supports multiple Hosts is installed once, using the first available Host.
